title: AI-Powered GaP Repository: Democratizing Access to Political Knowledge for Young Women in South Asia
summary: The Centre for Gender and Politics proposes multilingual NLP, contextual recommendations, and mentorship matching for young women in South Asia.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed AI version of the GaP repository would add multilingual information access, contextual recommendations, and mentorship matching. The already launched version is a conventional content-management system and is not counted as an AI-produced benefit. This record concerns the intended contribution of the future AI functions to political-information access and guidance.
purpose: Use multilingual AI assistance and personalized matching to improve political-information access.

ratings.reason: Improved access and guidance through the proposed AI functions are intended; the existing CMS launch does not establish their benefit depth.
Greater political participation through AI-assisted access remains an intended downstream effect.

ai_role.statement: Proposed NLP, contextual recommendation, and mentorship-matching functions would personalize access and guidance.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Powered GaP Repository: Democratizing Access to Political Knowledge for Young Women in South Asia

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: GaP plans an AI interface for political knowledge

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
